spec_match.rationale: Runs the real ChaCha20-Poly1305 generateKey/encrypt/decrypt with a 12-byte iv and additionalData per RFC 8439 and the WICG draft, and probes the exact nonce-length contract by attempting a 16-byte iv expecting OperationError.

interactive.rationale: Editable plaintext and AAD fields, encrypt/decrypt/bad-nonce buttons, and two tamper checkboxes (ciphertext bit-flip, AAD change) driving a live nonce/ciphertext/verdict panel.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises encrypt/decrypt with 12-byte nonce and optional AAD, tag rejection on tampered ciphertext or wrong AAD, and the wrong-length-nonce OperationError; every element is implemented.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers both tamper channels separately, correctly frames tag rejection of tampered input as the passing outcome, distinguishes untampered decryption failure as a real error, and degrades honestly when the algorithm is absent.

references.rationale: Sibling links only — the page nowhere carries the https://chromestatus.com/feature/5198951632470016 self-heal link (a gap shared by all five webcrypto concepts).

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's method/secure-context assertions cover the shared gate this page depends on; current failures in unflagged Chromium 141 are the expected absent WebCryptoPQC surface.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the async supported() probe correctly revealed the flag note and warn status with the encrypt button disabled, zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; encryption and tamper flows could not be driven interactively here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts encrypt success/failure, the AEAD integrity contract on both tampered and untampered branches, and the nonce-length OperationError check.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours throughout, but the default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone, ~3.5:1) and AUTHENTIC verdict (--bg-ivory on --accent-emerald, ~4.0:1) sit under WCAG AA 4.5:1 at their small bold sizes.

accessibility.rationale: Every field has a visible label, checkboxes are native with text labels, the status line is role=status aria-live, the ciphertext cell is aria-live, and verdicts are textual.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow with full-width inputs and wrapping controls; desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link to this page's see-also
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires the chromestatus.com/feature/5198951632470016 link on every page as the slug self-heal anchor; this page links siblings only. One-line additive fix shared across the webcrypto concept set.

openQuestions.title: Fix sub-AA contrast on the warn status and AUTHENTIC verdict
openQuestions.detail: status-line.warn (--accent-amber on --bg-stone) renders by default in every unflagged browser at ~3.5:1 and verdict.ok (--bg-ivory on --accent-emerald) at ~4.0:1 — both below AA for 0.78–0.8rem bold text. Prefer --text-black on emerald and a darker amber; the pattern repeats across the five webcrypto pages.

openQuestions.title: Record the flagged-browser AEAD success and rejection evidence
openQuestions.detail: In this unflagged Chromium 141 the cipher is absent, so encrypt/decrypt, the two tamper rejections, and the 16-byte-nonce OperationError were not observed live. Exercise all four branches once in a WebCryptoPQC-enabled Chrome 150+ and record the statuses.

summary: A complete AEAD contract demo — encrypt, authentic decrypt, ciphertext and AAD tamper rejection, and the exact 12-byte nonce rule — with honest capability probing that disables encryption rather than faking it. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): honest warn state, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on mobile or desktop. Open items match the sibling pages: chromestatus link, amber/emerald contrast, flagged-browser evidence.
